# NOTES: "A Bid for Fortune; or, Dr. Nikola's Vendetta" by Guy Boothby (1918, Ward Lock). Single book, Part I and Part II.

## Front matter / Prologue: DR. NIKOLA (London, Imperial Restaurant, Thames Embankment)
- Manager **Mr. McPherson** (33 yrs in business) receives odd letter from **Cuyaba, Brazil**, dated 3 months earlier, ordering a private dinner for 4 at 8 pm, room No. 22, candles with red shades, porcelain saucer and jug of new milk on mantelpiece, no electric light. Guests: one from **Hang-chow**, one from **Bloemfontein**, one resident in England; each presents plain visiting card with red dot. Chief bookkeeper **Miss O'Sullivan** (28, tall, pretty) helps read; head waiter **Williams**; waiters Jones, Edmunds, Brooks, Tomkins; hall porter.
- Guests: **Eastover** (tall, best-dressed, slight American accent, "three minutes to eight", had dealt with host in Nashville, Tahupapa NZ, Papeete, Pekin); **Prendergast** (second-tallest, face pitted with smallpox, snow-white hair; prior: Brussels, Monte Video, Mandalay, Gold Coast); **Baxter** (undersized, clean-shaven, clerical dress, bow legs; prior: Cabul, Nijni Novgorod, Wilcannia, Valparaiso, Nagasaki).
- **Dr. Nikola** arrives (33, slim, olive skin, black hair, pitted-free, black eyes, pearly teeth; dandy). Black cat in basket, cat sits on his shoulder. Says he was in Brazil; collision in Channel that morning.
- Job: L300,000 cheque man (unnamed, "Wetherell" addressed as "my friend Wetherell" in Nikola's monologue) to be ruined; pay L10,000 each if success, else L1,000 + expenses. Eastover → Sydney by Wednesday boat, meet Nikola next evening. Prendergast → Dover, Paris, letter; answer at Charing Cross porch Thursday 2:30. Baxter → tutor to young **Marquis of Beckenham** (son of **Duke of Glenbarth**, "Mad Duke", house at Bournemouth; Baxter to foster travel desire). Photograph of boy. Nikola's lair: **Green Sailor** public-house, East India Dock Road.

## PART I, CHAPTER I: "I determine to take a Holiday" (narrator Richard "Dick" Hatteras)
- Age 28, six feet two, 46-inch chest; pearler, copra, beche-de-mer dealer at Thursday Island, N. Queensland. Father James English (schooner *Helen of Troy* lost, cyclone); mother died of fever in Philippines. Left on *Little Emily*. Had L5,000 from mining venture. Father's Latin book (Catullus) with inscription.
- Sydney: swindler **Dorunda Dodson** (named "Mr. _Dorunda_ Dodson") tries to cheat him; Hatteras exposes him. Domain: rescues **Phyllis Wetherell** (21-22, brown hair, blue eyes, green dress, marten boa, flimsy hat) from three larrikins (leader "Dog"). Her father **Hon. Sylvester Wetherell**, Colonial Secretary, Potts Point. Ship *Orizaba*, from Sydney. Ports: Adelaide, Albany, Lewin, Colombo, Aden, Port Said, Naples. On deck, Wetherell forbids engagement; Phyllis's note "MY OWN DEAREST... P.S. ... your address in London." Proposal at sea near Naples.

## CHAPTER II: LONDON
- Wetherells at **Hotel Metropole**. Meet British Museum entrance hall 11 am; Egyptian room. Ring given (Phyllis). Phyllis says father "promised she could marry whom she pleased if honourable"; Wetherell has a mysterious fear of someone.
- Restaurant (French, corner; Frenchman proprietor). Upstairs: chess game; tall man with black hair, olive skin (= Nikola) beats smaller artist (pince-nez, red lake stain) playing German. Nikola: "limitations of the fool are the birth gifts of the wise"; "half the world is born for the other half to prey upon." Reveals cards in Hatteras's pocket: Edward Braithwaite (Macquarrie St, Sydney), Hon. Sylvester Wetherell (Potts Point), Richard Hatteras. Fly-paper vision in glass dish: Phyllis crying, "Oh, Dick! Dick! come to me!" Dish shatters; Nikola vanishes.
- Next morning: Wetherells gone to Paris (on hall porter's word).
- Letter from Phyllis (posted Dover, "MONDAY AFTERNOON"): father fainted, saw someone, must leave for Paris to catch Naples–Australia boat.

## CHAPTER III: I VISIT MY RELATIONS
- New Forest village near Lyndhurst Road; old driver (70s). Family house **Murdlestone**/"the Hall", grey stone, griffins on gate posts. Uncle **Sir William Hatteras** (75ish, white whiskers, hawk eyes, finger-tip-to-tip habit). Old manservant; wife cook. Uncle insists father was "James," borrowed half-crown; Catullus bought for 18d 3 July 1833, John Burns, Fleet St. Uncle wants £1,000 for daughter **Gwendoline** (3-ft, bearded, idiot). Hatteras refuses, insults him. Clergyman (rector) confirms no claim.
- Advertisement: yacht *Enchantress*, ten tons, agents Screw & Matchem, Bournemouth.

## CHAPTER IV: I SAVE AN IMPORTANT LIFE
- Bournemouth; cruise, bather near Canford Cliffs/Alum Chine rescued: **Marquis of Beckenham** (~19, boyish voice, tutor "Mr. Baxter" waiting on beach; tutor claimed missionary, South Seas). Baxter's odd manner. Duke of Glenbarth's house on cliff (Sandridge Castle / West Cliff).

## CHAPTER V: MYSTERY
- Duke visits Hatteras at hotel; says he knew James; plans for son's education; Hatteras suggests travel. Duke's "Poor Jim!" Hatteras describes Australia to Beckenham.
- Post office: Baxter at desk; pencil impression: "LETTER RECEIVED. YOU OMMITTED REVEREDN. THE TRAIN IS LAID, BUT A NEW ELEMENT OF DANGER HAS ARISEN." Addressed "Nikola, Green Sailor Hotel, East India Dock Road," signed "Nineveh." Hatteras keeps form.
- Hatteras sends reply to "John Nicholson, Langham Hotel": "The train is laid, but a new danger has arisen. HATTERAS." Baxter reacts (Andamans question). Baxter confronts Hatteras outside Duke's house.

## CHAPTER VI: I MEET DR. NIKOLA AGAIN
- Trafalgar Square: **Jim Percival**, officer of *Yarraman* (Riley chief officer, Cleary third, Maclean engineer). Hatteras books *Saratoga* for Friday. Dinner aboard.
- East India Dock Road, *Green Sailor*: Baxter in non-clerical dress with Nikola. Nikola warns: "don't go"; attempts hypnosis. Beckenham letter: Baxter & he sail on *Saratoga*. Duke's letter: Earl of Amberley (Governor NSW). Phyllis letter from Port Said (Prendergast annoying).
- Train to Plymouth; Nikola joins; drugs Hatteras. Wakes Plymouth, Ship & Vulture Hotel, Room 37; Saturday; missed *Saratoga*.

## CHAPTER VII: PORT SAID, AND WHAT BEFEL US THERE
- Naples; Beckenham and Baxter on *Saratoga*. Beckenham seasick (coffee drugged by Baxter). Port Said: beggar cripple (iron-shod crutch); mosque; English tourists; guide traitor; escape over wall; Casino; garrotted in Arab Town (Greek-named sign).

## CHAPTER VIII: OUR IMPRISONMENT AND ATTEMPT AT ESCAPE
- Iron collars in brick room; Prendergast (white hair, pitted). Negro servant. Mice carry messages through pipe to cripple; file, £5 note. Escape to corridor; break door.

## CHAPTER IX: DR. NIKOLA PERMITS US A FREE PASSAGE
- Laboratory of Nikola (preserved bodies, weapons, Burmese monkey-boy, Indian hydrocephalic man, albino dwarf, Greek). Nikola returns letters and £5 note; frees them blindfolded. Agent at *Saratoga* says Beckenham was found and went on; Baxter/substitute. Hatteras and Beckenham sail on *Pescadore* (Hull) to Melbourne.

## PART II, CHAPTER I: WE REACH AUSTRALIA, AND THE RESULT
- *Pescadore* lands at Williamstown, 36 days. Sydney, *General Officer* hotel, Palgrave Street. Newspaper: false Beckenham at Government House, with Baxter. Theatre: false Marquis looks like Beckenham. Man from train (Eastover) on ferry. Potts Point: Phyllis says a suitor (sham Marquis) courting her. Wetherell rejects Hatteras; threatens. Beckenham missing. Police. *Evening Mercury* announces engagement. Wetherell confesses to Lord Amberley; Phyllis lured away ("Mr. Wetherell taken ill") by Baxter/Mrs. Mayford's ball.

## PART II, CHAPTER II: ON THE TRAIL
- Coachman **Thompson** drugged by "friend" (Eastover/Nikola) at *Canary Bird Hotel*; ring with black snake eyes. Landlord Mr. Bartrell; barman. Envelope piece "----swell Street, Woolahra." Stationer **W. E. Maxwell**, 23 Ipswell St; chemist **Podgers** (chloroform, "J. Venneage, 22 Calliope Street"). No. 22 Calliope St: Beckenham found gagged and bound.

## PART II, CHAPTER III: LORD BECKENHAM'S STORY
- Beckenham in Botanic Gardens met **Mathew Draper** (old South-Sea merchant); carriage to villa; Nikola; **Eastover**; drink; drugged. Rope "seized" clue, green paint. Inspector **Murdkin**. House 83 Charlemagne Street (headless eagle); Miss Tiffins (dressmaker); Goddard & James furniture van; Eastover hired curios. Draper: schooner *Merry Duchess*. Letter from "THE MAN WHO KNOWS" demanding £100,000 and "little stick from China Pete" (8 pm, Shark Point).

## PART II, CHAPTER IV: FOLLOWING UP A CLUE
- Footman James (received letter from little old woman); parlour maid spy; Sally (old woman) and younger girl. Plan: dummy bags; Shark Point; waterman **James Burbidge**; *Maid of the Mist* barque; second letter ("THE MAN WHO KNOWS"). Hatteras followed maid to Sally's house; overheard "Pipa Lannu," *Merry Duchess*. McMurtough's steam yacht hired; Winchester rifles. Dawson & Gladman advertisement; Hatteras inherits baronetcy: Sir Richard Hatteras of Murdlestone (cousin Gwendoline drowned; uncle died), £15,000 a year, ~£100,000 capital. Bank: Oceania.

## PART II, CHAPTER V: THE ISLANDS, AND WHAT WE FOUND THERE
- Voyage toward New Hebrides; Aneityum. Wetherell's story: China Pete (Chinese murder trial, defended by Wetherell); stick (Llamaserai, Peking; "ten millions"). Nikola offers to buy; Wetherell refuses; burglary; China Pete's stick. Plan: landing party of 8 (Wetherell, Beckenham, mate, Hatteras, 4 crew). Beckenham wants to be best man.

## PART II, CHAPTER VI: CONCLUSION
- Pipa Lannu raid; Hatteras kills/subdues sentry; Phyllis rescued; Wetherell captured by Nikola's schooner, tied in north cave; Nikola takes stick, Baxter bows. Phyllis's story: Baxter took her from ball; kept in house; schooner. Wedding at cathedral; Beckenham best man. Nikola's gift: diamond collet, card "From her sincere admirer, Dr. Nikola." Honeymoon in Blue Mountains; return to England in *Orizaba*; Wetherell resigned; Hatteras's Forest residence. Ends with narrator's fear of Nikola. THE END.
